system.description: You like a big slab of wood or metal between you and the beasties. When you are attacked by a physical Attack, spend one Action to make a separate Shield Block Skill Check vs. the Mob's 'to hit' for each of the Attacks targeting you. On Success, take half the damage before applying your DR. Your Shield takes a -1 DR penalty on a Major Fail; -2 on a Critical Fail. It breaks at 0 DR. However, a broken shield and lost DR can be Repaired.

upgrades.description: You may also use this Skill against Spells and magical damage.
On a Critical Hit, you may make a Shield Bash Attack as a free melee-range Interrupt Attack (instead of Advantage on your next Attack) if you wish, dealing 3d6 base damage + STR Bludgeoning.
+1d6 Shield Bash damage. Further reduce the damage you would take by your STR Mod.

system.limitations: Requires you to be wielding a shield. Cannot be used against Area of Effect damage. A successful Shield Block still counts as 'a hit crawler' or 'a crawler who failed to Evade.'
